encoding.fieldElement: BN254 scalar field element, serialized as a 32-byte big-endian value
encoding.order: Declaration order of `pub` parameters in noir/zkc_credential_rebind_auth_v2/src/main.nr main(); arrays are flattened element-wise
encoding.integers: Unsigned integers are zero-extended into a single field element
encoding.byteArrays: [u8; N] occupies N field elements, one byte per element, in array order

publicInputs.name: old_presentation_pseudonym
publicInputs.description: H("zkc/presentation-scope:v1", oldCbk, scopeId): the old holder's scoped pseudonym

publicInputs.name: new_presentation_pseudonym
publicInputs.description: H("zkc/presentation-scope:v1", newCbk, scopeId): the new holder's scoped pseudonym; MUST differ from old

publicInputs.name: scope_id
publicInputs.description: Shared verifier/protocol scope for both pseudonyms; rebind requires a scoped presentation (0 is rejected)

publicInputs.name: credential_id
publicInputs.description: Identifier of the credential being rebound; authenticated by the issuer-signed rebind attestation and proven non-revoked in the same accumulator

publicInputs.name: issuer_id_hash
publicInputs.description: string_to_field(issuerId) of the issuer that signed the rebind attestation; bound into the recomputed transcript, so it is authenticated rather than asserted

publicInputs.name: schema_id_hash
publicInputs.description: string_to_field(schemaId) of the credential schema; bound into the recomputed transcript

publicInputs.name: proof_context
publicInputs.description: Deployment/profile-defined replay context hash; MUST be non-zero

publicInputs.name: timestamp
publicInputs.description: Rebind timestamp; MUST be non-zero and lie inside the issuer-signed credential validity period

publicInputs.name: claim_binding
publicInputs.description: Claim binding over (oldPresentationPseudonym, newPresentationPseudonym, credentialId, proofContext, timestamp)

publicInputs.name: accumulator_root
publicInputs.description: Issuer-published non-revocation accumulator root the membership witness verifies against

publicInputs.name: accumulator_epoch
publicInputs.description: Epoch of the accumulator root; in-circuit freshness requires current_epoch - accumulator_epoch <= MAX_EPOCH_LAG

publicInputs.name: current_epoch
publicInputs.description: Verifier's current accumulator epoch view for the proof's issuer

publicInputs.name: issuer_public_key_x
publicInputs.description: secp256k1 issuer public key X coordinate the rebind attestation signature is verified against

publicInputs.name: issuer_public_key_y
publicInputs.description: secp256k1 issuer public key Y coordinate the rebind attestation signature is verified against
